questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the total voters cast their votes. Out of the total votes cast, 10% were declared invalid. If Candidate A secured 70% of the valid votes and Candidate B received the rest, and the total number of eligible voters was 50,000. How many votes did candidate A receive?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total votes cast = 80% of 50,000 = 0.8 × 50,000 = 40,000.

Valid votes = 90% of 40,000 = 0.9 × 40,000 = 36,000.

Votes for Candidate A = 70% of valid votes = 0.7 × 36,000 = 25,200.

**∴ Answer = 25,200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total eligible voters = 50,000

Total votes cast = 80% of eligible voters

Invalid votes = 10% of total votes cast

Candidate A received 70% of valid votes

**Formula used:**

Valid votes = Total votes cast × (1 − Invalid %)

Votes for Candidate A = Valid votes × Candidate A's percentage

 Total Eligible Voters = 50,000 Total Votes Cast = 40,000 (80% of 50,000) Valid Votes = 36,000 (90% of 40,000) 

**Calculations:**

Total votes cast = 80% of 50,000 ⇒ 0.8 × 50,000 = 40,000

⇒ Valid votes = 90% of 40,000 ⇒ 0.9 × 40,000 = 36,000

⇒ Candidate A's votes = 70% of valid votes ⇒ 0.7 × 36,000 = 25,200

**∴ The correct answer is 25,200 (Option 1).**

questions.question: Ravi spends ₹80 more than Raj. If together they spend ₹380, how much does Raj spend?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Raj's spending = ₹x.

Ravi spends ₹80 more than Raj ⇒ Ravi's spending = ₹x + 80.

Total spending = ₹380 ⇒ x + (x + 80) = 380.

Solving: 2x + 80 = 380 ⇒ 2x = 300 ⇒ x = 150.

**∴ Answer = ₹150**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total spending = ₹380, Ravi spends ₹80 more than Raj.

**Formula used:**

Total spending = Raj's spending + Ravi's spending.

 Raj: ₹x Ravi: ₹x + ₹80 
• Total = ₹380 

**Calculations:**

Let Raj's spending = ₹x.

⇒ Ravi's spending = ₹x + ₹80.

⇒ Total spending = x + (x + 80) = 380.

⇒ 2x + 80 = 380 ⇒ 2x = 300 ⇒ x = 150.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹150 (Option 1).**

questions.question: A jeep travels 80 km at the speed of 40 km/hr and the next 32 km at the speed of 16 km/hr. What is its average speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A jeep travels two distances at different speeds. Average speed formula for unequal distances:

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 80 + 32 = 112 km

Total Time = (80 ÷ 40) + (32 ÷ 16) = 2 + 2 = 4 hours

**∴ Answer = 112 ÷ 4 = 28 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 = 80 km, Speed 1 = 40 km/hr

Distance 2 = 32 km, Speed 2 = 16 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 Distance 1: 80 km Speed 1: 40 km/hr Distance 2: 32 km Speed 2: 16 km/hr 
• Total Distance: 112 km 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 80 + 32 = 112 km

⇒ Total Time = (80 ÷ 40) + (32 ÷ 16) = 2 + 2 = 4 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 112 ÷ 4 = 28 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 28 km/hr (Option 1).**

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an article for ₹12,000 and sells it for ₹13,500. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price = ₹13,500 − ₹12,000 = ₹1,500

Profit % = (₹1,500 ÷ ₹12,000) × 100

Profit % = 12.5%

**∴ Answer = 12.5%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹12,000

Selling Price (SP) = ₹13,500

**Formula used:**

Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

 
 
 
• 
 CP = ₹12,000
 SP = ₹13,500
 Profit = ₹1,500

**Calculations:**

Profit = SP − CP = ₹13,500 − ₹12,000 = ₹1,500

⇒ Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 = (₹1,500 ÷ ₹12,000) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 12.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 12.5% (Option 3).**

questions.question: The average age of 25 students of a class is 33 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 34 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher's age = Old average + Extra per person contribution

⇒ Increase in average = 34 − 33 = 1

⇒ Extra total = 1 × 26 = 26

⇒ Teacher's age = 33 + 26 = 59

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 25 students = 33 years.

New average including teacher = 34 years.

Total number of individuals = 26.

**Formula used:**

Age of teacher = (New average × Total individuals) − (Previous average × Number of students).

 25 Students Avg = 33 Teacher Age = ? Group Avg = 34 
• 
• 

**Calculations:**

Total age of students = 25 × 33 = 825 years.

⇒ Total age including teacher = 26 × 34 = 884 years.

⇒ Age of teacher = 884 − 825 = 59 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 59 years (Option 4).**

questions.question: The insect population in a building was 9580 in 2015. It increased by 12% in 2016, decreased by 8% in 2017, and again increased by 8% in 2018. Find the insect population in 2018, rounded off to the nearest integer.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial population = 9580

Increase in 2016 = 12%

Decrease in 2017 = 8%

Increase in 2018 = 8%

**Formula Used:**

New value = Old value × (1 ± percentage ÷ 100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Population in 2016 = 9580 × 112 ÷ 100 = 10729.6

⇒ Population in 2017 = 10729.6 × 92 ÷ 100 = 9871.232

⇒ Population in 2018 = 9871.232 × 108 ÷ 100 = 10661.93056

⇒ Rounded value = 10661

**∴ The correct answer is 10661.**

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 3, 9 and 18 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to complete thrice the same work, working together?2522
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 9 days

Time taken by C = 18 days

Total work = 3 times

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = LCM ÷ Time

Total time = Total work ÷ Total efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 3, 9, 18 = 18

⇒ Efficiency of A = 18 ÷ 3 = 6

⇒ Efficiency of B = 18 ÷ 9 = 2

⇒ Efficiency of C = 18 ÷ 18 = 1

⇒ Total efficiency = 6 + 2 + 1 = 9

⇒ Total work = 3 × 18 = 54

⇒ Time = 54 ÷ 9 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

questions.question: A train passes two tunnels of length 2708 m and 2195 m in 88 seconds and 76 seconds, respectively. What is the length of the train?

Time taken = 76

Speed = (Length of train + Length of tunnel) ÷ Time

questions.question: The median of the data 4, 23, 11, 7, 6, 9, (K + 5) , 15, 20 and 16 is 12. Find the value of K.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total number of observations = 10

Median = 12

Unknown term = K + 5

**Formula Used:**

Median for even number of observations = (n/2th term + (n/2 + 1)th term) ÷ 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ Arranging known values in ascending order: 4, 6, 7, 9, 11, (K + 5), 15, 16, 20, 23

⇒ Median = (5th term + 6th term) ÷ 2

⇒ 12 = (11 + (K + 5)) ÷ 2

⇒ 12 × 2 = 11 + K + 5

⇒ 24 = K + 16

⇒ K = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

questions.question: A solid metallic sphere of radius 10.5 cm is melted and recast into smaller spherical balls of radius 1.5 cm each. If the surface area of the original sphere is S, what is the total surface area of all the small balls combined?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of large sphere = 10.5 cm

Radius of small sphere = 1.5 cm

Surface area of large sphere = S

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Surface area of sphere = 4 × π × r²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Number of small spheres = (10.5 ÷ 1.5)³

⇒ Number of small spheres = 7³

⇒ Number of small spheres = 343

⇒ Surface area of one small sphere = 4 × π × (1.5)²

⇒ Surface area of one small sphere = 4 × π × 2.25

⇒ Total surface area of small spheres = 343 × 4 × π × 2.25

⇒ Total surface area of small spheres = 343 × 9 × π

⇒ Total surface area of small spheres = 3087 × π

⇒ Surface area of large sphere S = 4 × π × (10.5)²

⇒ S = 4 × π × 110.25

⇒ S = 441 × π

⇒ Ratio = (3087 × π) ÷ (441 × π)

⇒ Ratio = 7

⇒ Total surface area = 7 × S

**∴ The correct answer is 7S.**

x% = x ÷ 100

Fraction of a number = fraction × number

**Calculation:**

⇒ 70% = 70 ÷ 100 = 7 ÷ 10

⇒ Number = 539 × 60 ÷ 7

⇒ Number = 539 × (60 ÷ 7)

questions.question: The sum of three numbers is 8788. If the ratio between the first and second numbers is 20 :18 and that of between second and third is 21 : 12, then find the difference between the first and the third number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of three numbers = 8788

Ratio of first : second = 20 : 18

Ratio of second : third = 21 : 12

**Formula Used:**

If a : b and b : c are given, make b equal to combine ratios

Sum = (sum of ratio parts) × common factor

**Calculation:**

⇒ first : second = 20 : 18

⇒ second : third = 21 : 12

⇒ LCM of 18 and 21 = 126

⇒ first : second = 20 × 7 : 18 × 7 = 140 : 126

⇒ second : third = 21 × 6 : 12 × 6 = 126 : 72

⇒ first : second : third = 140 : 126 : 72

⇒ Sum of ratios = 140 + 126 + 72 = 338

⇒ One part = 8788 ÷ 338

⇒ One part = 26

⇒ First number = 140 × 26 = 3640

⇒ Third number = 72 × 26 = 1872

⇒ Difference = 3640 − 1872

⇒ Difference = 1768

**∴ The correct answer is 1768.**

questions.question: The ratio of the present age of Sunil and Shyam is 3 : 4. The ratio of their age after 25 years from now, will be 8 : 9. What is the present age of Sunil?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Present age ratio = 3 : 4

Age ratio after 25 years = 8 : 9

**Formula Used:**

Age = Ratio × common factor

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present ages = 3x and 4x

⇒ (3x + 25) ÷ (4x + 25) = 8 ÷ 9

⇒ 9(3x + 25) = 8(4x + 25)

⇒ 27x + 225 = 32x + 200

⇒ 225 − 200 = 32x − 27x

⇒ 25 = 5x

⇒ x = 5

⇒ Present age of Sunil = 3x = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

19 men and 13 women can complete a piece of work in 12 days, while 17 men and 9 women can complete the same work in 14 days. The work of how many women is equivalent to that of one man?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

19 men + 13 women → 12 days

17 men + 9 women → 14 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency ∝ 1 ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ (19M + 13W) × 12 = (17M + 9W) × 14

⇒ 228M + 156W = 238M + 126W

⇒ 156W − 126W = 238M − 228M

⇒ 30W = 10M

⇒ 1M = 3W

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Nirmal borrowed an amount of ₹2,40,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Nirmal after 3 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simple Interest difference = (Principal × Rate difference × Time) ÷ 100

⇒ Rate difference = 7.5 − 3.5 = 4

⇒ 4 × 3 = 12

⇒ Difference = 240000 × 12 ÷ 100

⇒ = 28800

**∴ Answer = ₹28,800**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal for each bank = ₹2,40,000

Rate for Bank A = 3.5% per annum

Rate for Bank B = 7.5% per annum

Time = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest: I = PRT/100

 Bank A: 3.5% Bank B: 7.5% 
• 
• ₹25,200 ₹54,000 
• Difference 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Bank A: I = ₹2,40,000 × 3.5 × 3 ÷ 100 = ₹25,200

⇒ Bank B: I = ₹2,40,000 × 7.5 × 3 ÷ 100 = ₹54,000

⇒ Positive difference = ₹54,000 − ₹25,200 = ₹28,800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28,800 (Option 2).**
